blind.description: A stylized decorative standing candle holder featuring a tiered circular base, a turned baluster stem with two bulbous ribbed sections decorated with alternating red and cream vertical stripes, and a wide top drip pan fringed with triangular sunburst rays. Centered on the tray is a short, thick cylindrical cream candle with an unlit black wick. Surfaces are clean, solid, and smoothly stylized with warm bronze, red, and cream painted textures.
blind.from_above: A concentric sunburst design showing a circular cream candle with a central wick dot, set inside a golden circular bowl bordered by radiating triangular sun rays.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands approximately half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 2.5 to 3 ft tall) and roughly 1 ft wide at the sunburst tray and base.
